title: Expected biased-cube monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p=(p_i)_{i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)}$ satisfy $0<p_i<1$ for every coordinate, and let $S\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. Under the independent product distribution with coordinate parameters $p$, the expectation of the sign monomial indexed by $S$ is $\prod_{i\in S}(1-2p_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: Each parameter $p_i$ lies strictly between $0$ and $1$
